note: Two sets: selling-channel colours (--hb-mkt-*) and fulfilment-location colours (--hb-fl-*). A chart plots one set or the other, never a mix. shared by every app that draws a chart (P12: the map is config, not code). Each entry has a value for the dark app ground (#0b1618) and one for the CFO's warm paper (#fff1e5); both meet 3:1 against their ground. Hues are from the Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe set where possible. Sibling channels (two Shopify stores) share a hue and differ in lightness; in a stacked chart they also need a separator, because lightness alone cannot reach 3:1 between them on the paper ground. Adding a marketplace means adding a row here and regenerating the tokens; never picking a colour in an app. Region anchors are Toby's team palette (21/09/26): UK yellow, US red, EU blue, MWH green, everywhere.
